name: Promptbreeder (Self-Referential Self-Improvement)
executive_summary: Evolve a population of prompts using an LLM-driven mutation-and-selection loop, including mutating the mutation-prompts themselves.
description: Maintains a population of task-prompts, evaluates them on a training set, and evolves the population via LLM-generated mutations (rewording, hybridization, or entirely new prompts). Critically, the mutation-prompts that generate these mutations are themselves part of the evolving population, making the system self-referential: it can improve its own means of self-improvement, not just the end task-prompt.
when_to_use: A reusable prompt for a fixed task needs to be found automatically and a labeled train/held-out split exists to score candidates.
when_not_to_use: One-off queries with no reusable prompt being optimized, or no labeled evaluation set to score fitness against.
known_pitfalls: Search cost is substantial (many generations x population size x eval-set size); overfitting the training split without a genuinely held-out test split invalidates the result — see the selection-protocol literature.

primary_source.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement via Prompt Evolution

usage_templates.template:
# Mutate (per population member, using a mutation-prompt)
Mutation instruction: {{mutation_prompt}}
Original task-prompt: {{parent_prompt}}
Produce a mutated task-prompt.

# Evaluate (per mutated candidate, on the held-out fitness set)
Score {{mutated_prompt}} by running it against {{fitness_examples}} and measuring {{fitness_metric}}.

# Select
Keep the top {{population_size}} candidates by fitness for the next generation; occasionally also mutate the mutation-prompts themselves.

variables.name: mutation_prompt
variables.description: The (also-evolving) instruction used to mutate a task-prompt

variables.name: fitness_examples
variables.description: Held-out labeled examples used to score candidates

variables.name: fitness_metric
variables.description: The scoring metric, e.g. exact-match accuracy

variables.name: population_size
variables.description: How many candidates survive each generation

usage_templates.reproducibility_note: This template intentionally samples multiple times or explores adaptively; outputs vary run to run by design (explicit temperature>0 sampling, or multi-branch search whose path depends on intermediate stochastic choices).
